caption: The drawing consists of bold black text on a light background, with the largest text reading "FRED'K C. WAGNER" near the bottom. At the top, the text states, "FOR COUNCILMAN-47th District." with "AMERICAN" on the left side and "NOMINATION" on the right. In the center, there is a large eagle with extended wings pointing left and right, holding a banner in its beak that reads "INTERESTS OF THE PEOPLE" with the word "TO THE" on a smaller strip and "PEOPLE" at the end. The eagle's talons clutch a shield and some arrows. To the left of the eagle is a circular illustration showing a group of people gathered around a pedestal inscribed "CONSTITUTION AND LAWS," which is at the end of steps with more people ascending toward it. To the right of the eagle is an illustration of a muscular arm, bent at the elbow, holding a hammer. Across the bottom is a publisher's line: "OLIVER & BROTHER, Neat, Quick and Cheap Political Printers, 32 Beekman-St." The composition uses only black ink on a plain, light-colored background, with strong contrasts and sharp lines.
title: Election Poster
